rationale: Keep GCT Global Container Terminals Inc. as the single canonical Canadian terminal platform and retire the unsuffixed seed-only duplicate. GCT, Global Container Terminals and the unsuffixed form are aliases of the same legal parent. Ontario Teachers', IFM Investors and BCI remain current owners at 37.5%, 37.5% and 25%, respectively; no later ownership transfer or signed pending platform sale was found through August 19, 2026. Deltaport, Vanterm and GCT Canada LP remain subsidiaries or assets, while the former U.S. terminals were sold in 2023.

companyFieldUpdates.description: GCT Global Container Terminals Inc. is a Canadian marine-terminal operator serving containerized trade through the Port of Vancouver. The platform operates GCT Deltaport in Delta and GCT Vanterm in Vancouver, providing vessel, yard, gate, on-dock rail and truck-appointment services to ocean carriers, rail and trucking partners, logistics providers and cargo owners. Current company materials report four berths and nearly 3.5 million TEUs of annual capacity. Ontario Teachers' established the platform in 2007; IFM Investors and BCI joined in 2018, producing the current 37.5%, 37.5% and 25% ownership split. The U.S. terminals were sold to CMA CGM in 2023, leaving the two-terminal Canadian scope. No later ownership transfer or signed pending platform sale was identified through August 19, 2026.

set.event: Ontario Teachers' completed the initial acquisition of predecessor terminal businesses and established GCT as a North American container-terminal platform.
IFM Investors and BCI completed their equity investment alongside Ontario Teachers' in GCT.
The completed equity partnership set ownership at 37.5% Ontario Teachers', 37.5% IFM Investors and 25% BCI.
